RE: Final Environmental Impact
Statement
Kendall Square
Urban Renewal Project
Cambridge, Massachusetts
HUD Project No., Mass R-107
Pursuant to Section 10% (2) (C) of P.L. 91-190 and implementing Federal Regulations, I am forwarding a copy of the Final Environmental Impact Statement for the Kendall Square Urban Renewal Project in Cambridge, Massachusetts.
The Draft Environmental Impact Statement was distributed for review and comment on June 21, 1974. Comments were received on the Draft and they were taken into account in the review and decision process of the plans for this project.
This Statement contains all the comments received and responses to those comments.
If you have any comments on the Final Environmental Impact Statement, please submit them within thirty (30) days of the date this Statement is published in the Federal Register. Any comments received will be carefully considered in refining the plans for Kendall Square Urban Renewal Area.
Copies of the Final Environmental Statement are available for reading by the public in the Information Center in the HUD Regional Office in the JFK Federal Building, and the Area Office in Boston, Massachusetts.
Retention copies may be purchased by the public from the Boston Area Office.
Please sent your comments in writing to:
Marvin Siflinger
Acting Area Office Director
15 New Chardon Street
Boston, Massachusetts 02114
Attn: Environmental Clearance Officer
